description: Opaque cream linen knee-length undertunic beneath a long plum-brown open outer coat. Narrow gold geometric woven borders edge the split neckline, coat front, cuffs and hem. Cream inner cuffs show at the wrists. The outer sleeves are wide and layered with an elbow-length outer section over full sleeves. A narrow brown leather waist belt closes with a small round gold clasp and has a long strap end. Cream loose trousers tuck into tall brown leather boots with diagonal bindings. Fabric is textured and orderly. No head covering, armor, weapon or shoulder mantle is present.
